meta.name: Munchkin Brass Sigil
meta.description: A pewter sigil forged in the obsidian crucible. According to the Paradox Symposium of St. Munchkin, tools break because they believe they are tools; this sigil convinces them they are immortal paperweights. Drastically reduces durability wear at the cost of being heavily intoxicated by a sommelier's spell, drifting the quarry grid.
